description:
Port upstream formatSkillsForPrompt() to Elixir and wire into SystemPrompt.render/1.

Upstream format (skills.ts:339):
  \n\nThe following skills provide specialized instructions for specific tasks.
  Use the read tool to load a skill's file when the task matches its description.
  When a skill file references a relative path, resolve it against the skill directory...

  <available_skills>
    <skill>
      <name>my-skill</name>
      <description>Does X when Y</description>
      <location>/abs/path/to/SKILL.md</location>
    </skill>
  </available_skills>

Rules:
- Skills with disable_model_invocation: true are excluded
- Section is only appended when read tool is in active tool list (has_read guard)
- XML entities escaped: & → & < → < > → > " → " ' → '

Implementation:
- Add format_skills_section/2 to OctoPi.Coder.SystemPrompt (or inline in build_body)
- Add :skills opt to SystemPrompt.render/1 (list of %{name, description, file_path, disable_model_invocation})
- Appended after context_section, before date/cwd

Tests (TDD):
- Empty skills → no section added
- Single skill → correct XML format with all elements
- Skill with disable_model_invocation: true → excluded
- Multiple skills → all included in order
- XML entity escaping: & < > " ' in name/description/path
- No read tool → section omitted
- read tool present → section included

Reference: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/skills.ts formatSkillsForPrompt()
Reference: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/system-prompt.ts (skills section placement)
